title: DRL (Doom, the Roguelike)
tagline: Not shipped: id Software's audio and Doom's monsters, weapons and levels.
summary: This is an assessment folder, not a port. DRL's code is GPL-2.0 and its tiles are CC BY-SA 4.0, but its release ships id Software's Doom music and sound effects, ten music tracks under CC BY-NC-SA, and it is built on Doom's monsters, weapons, levels and story; an extra condition asks redistributors to inform the author.

The project ships only games whose code and every asset are free for any use including commercial, compatible with GPL-3.0+, and without trademark problems; DRL is none of these. LICENSE.md records the file-by-file assessment, re/drl/NOTES.md the sources.
